parameters.description:
`msg-to-brevo-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Brevo account — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Brevo accounts — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Brevo accounts bound per enrollment.

Sign in to Brevo, open SMTP & API, and create a Transactional email API key with send permission — set that key as BREVO_APIKEY. Make sure the address you want to send from is a verified sender (or part of an authenticated domain) in Brevo, and set it as BREVO_FROM_EMAIL; set the address that should receive the notification as BREVO_TO_EMAIL. Note: Brevo may email you a one-time IP-verification link the first time a new server calls the API — approve it to keep delivery running smoothly.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Brevo destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to Brevo v3 smtp/email
parameters.summary: Send an email through your own Brevo account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey.description: This enrollment's BREVO_APIKEY value (same format as BREVO_APIKEY). Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

from_email.description: This enrollment's BREVO_FROM_EMAIL value (same format as BREVO_FROM_EMAIL). Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

to_email.description: This enrollment's BREVO_TO_EMAIL value (same format as BREVO_TO_EMAIL). Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.
